title: Tenders & Quotations
body:
## Government Polytechnic College, Kannur
### Official Quotation Notice — PTA/01/2026-27

Sealed quotations are invited by the **Principal, Government Polytechnic College, Kannur** for the supply of printed Identity Cards for First Year Students as specified in the schedule below.

---

### 📋 Active Quotation / Tender Overview

| Item Detail | Information |
|:---|:---|
| **Quotation Number** | **PTA/01/2026-27** |
| **Work / Material Description** | **Printing & Supply of Identity Cards for First Year Students** |
| **Total Quantity** | **456 Nos.** |
| **Card Specification** | **CR-80 Standard Identity Card** |
| **Last Date & Time for Receipt** | **22.10.2026, 10:00 AM** |
| **Date & Time for Opening** | **22.10.2026, 12:00 Noon** |
| **Firmness of Rates** | **Rates to remain firm up to 30/05/2027** |
| **Issuing Authority** | **Principal, Govt. Polytechnic College, Kannur-7** |
| **Current Status** | 🟢 **ACTIVE / ACCEPTING SUBMISSIONS** |

---

### 📦 Schedule of Work & Specifications

| Sl. No. | Name of Work / Article | Quantity | Specifications |
|:---:|---|:---:|:---|
| 1 | **ID Card Printing** | **456 nos.** | **CR-80 Standard Format** |

#### Technical Requirements:
1. **Material Standard**: The contractor shall warrant that the material supplied shall be new and free from all defects, faults in material, workmanship, and manufacture, and shall be of the highest grade consistent with established standards.
2. **Delivery Conditions**: Tenderers must invariably specify delivery conditions, the time required for supply/completion, and the warranty/guarantee period.
3. **Free Replacement**: Replacement under warranty clause shall be made free of all charges at site including freight, insurance, cost of work, and other incidental charges.

---

### ✉️ Instructions for Submission

1. **Address & Superscription**: Sealed quotations should be superscribed with:
   > **"Quotation No. PTA/01/2026-27 for ID Card Printing for First Year Students"**
   
   And addressed to:
   > **The Principal**  
   > **Government Polytechnic College, Kannur**  
   > **Thottada P.O., Kannur — 670 007, Kerala**

2. **Due Date & Deadline**: Sealed covers must reach the college office on or before **22/10/2026, 10:00 AM**. Quotations received after the specified date and time are liable to be rejected.
3. **Opening Date**: Quotations will be opened at **12:00 Noon on 22/10/2026** in the presence of attending bidders or their authorized representatives.
4. **Security Deposit**: The successful tenderer must furnish **5% of the total contract amount as security deposit** within a specified period after acceptance of the quotation, and execute an agreement if required.
5. **Inclusive Rates**: Rates quoted must be inclusive of all taxes, duties, cesses, printing, and delivery charges at site.
6. **No Escalation**: No representation for enhancement of price once accepted will be considered during the currency of the contract.
